ogDescription:
An exceptionally rare opportunity within a connected Point Cook streetscape, these four neighbouring residences present a unique chance to secure multiple homes side-by-side — ideal for extended families, friends buying together, or investors seeking neighbouring assets in a high-demand location.

Each home has been thoughtfully designed for practical, low-maintenance living, combining modern finishes with functional family spaces. Covered entrances and landscaped front yards create an inviting first impression, while high ceilings, downlights, and bright open-plan interiors enhance the sense of comfort throughout.

At the centre of each residence, the L-shaped kitchen features a stone benchtop island, polished tile splashback, and 900mm gas cooktop, flowing seamlessly into the open living and dining zone with split-system cooling for year-round comfort.
The well-considered floorplan includes a privately positioned master bedroom with walk-in robe and ensuite, alongside three additional bedrooms fitted with built-in robes and serviced by a central bathroom with separate toilet. Landscaped low-maintenance backyards, dedicated laundries with side access, and double garages further add to the practicality and appeal.

Opportunities like this are exceptionally difficult to find — offering the flexibility to secure one, multiple, or an entire neighbouring collection within an established Point Cook pocket.

ogTitle: 2/41 Hyde Park Terrace, Point Cook, Vic 3030
ogDescription:
Peaceful, private and positioned directly opposite expansive parkland, this beautifully maintained three-bedroom home offers far more than first impressions suggest. Filled with natural light and designed with flexibility in mind, the generous floorplan delivers multiple living options, a private master balcony, excellent indoor-outdoor connection and an easy-care backyard. Whether you're buying your first home, looking for more room without the maintenance, or searching for a smart investment, this is comfortable, convenient living in a wonderfully quiet setting.

The B.est

• Three generous bedrooms and two bathrooms
• Spacious master suite with walk-in robe, private ensuite and its own balcony – the perfect spot to enjoy a morning coffee
• Beautifully light-filled, north-facing main living zone
• Well-appointed kitchen with stainless steel appliances, generous bench space and excellent storage
• Separate second living room or study offering genuine flexibility as a home office, children's retreat, TV room or quiet sitting area
• High ceilings enhancing the home's feeling of light and space
• Functional floorplan providing excellent separation between living and accommodation zones

The R.est

• Peaceful position overlooking expansive parkland and greenery
• Sliding doors connecting the living area with the private, low-maintenance backyard
• Easy-care outdoor space with plenty of potential for entertaining and relaxed weekend living
• Private balcony to the master bedroom
• Ducted heating and split-system air conditioning for year-round comfort
• Single remote garage with convenient internal access
• Quiet residential pocket with easy access to schools, shopping, everyday amenities and freeway connections
A Home That Makes Everyday Living Easy

There's something particularly appealing about having open parkland on your doorstep while still enjoying the convenience of everything you need close by. With three bedrooms, two separate living spaces, a sun-filled north-facing aspect and outdoor areas that won't consume your weekends, this is a home designed to adapt as life changes. Move in, make it yours and enjoy the space, privacy and lifestyle on offer.
